title: loomlc change
description: The edits a change step made, and the commits loomlc should record them as.

status.description: complete when the work is ready to review, needs_more when work remains, blocked when it can't continue.

summary.description: What changed and why, for the pull request description.

commits.description: The commits to make, in order. Empty only when nothing was changed.

message.description: For a new commit, a Conventional Commit message whose header is 72 characters or fewer. For a fix, the explanation that becomes the fixup commit's body.

paths.description: The files this commit covers, relative to the repository root. Each changed file belongs to exactly one commit.

fixes.description: Empty for a new logical commit. Otherwise the SHA, from the branch's commit list, of the commit on this branch that this fixes.

addressed.description: One entry per finding or feedback item, saying what was done about it.

item.description: Which finding or feedback item this answers, by its id or a short quotation.

response.description: What was done about it, or why it was declined.

blockers.description: What stopped the work, when status is blocked. Empty otherwise.
